title: Domo's Cozy Adventure
description: This project contains my modpack that my friends and I are playing on a private server. The modpack is mostly focused around Cobblemon and some Slice of Life mods.
body:
Domo's Cozy Adventure is a fun little modpack I decided to cook up to initially play in singleplayer, but my friends asked to play it with me. Thus, I decided to make it a project through Modrinth to make it easier for my friends to download and receive updates for it!

The modpack is mostly centralized around Cobblemon and Create, as they are some of my favorite mods to play. But there are a ton of slice of life related mods to also enhance the experience and make tasks like building and exploring more fun.

There are tons of options for furniture, building blocks, farming, food making, Create engineering, and more!

In our eyes, playing Minecraft is meant to be relaxing and enjoyable, which for us, is by doing things like building and making dumb machines or farm. (Plus, for me, Cobblemon is super fun and I absolutely love playing it!)


If anybody wants to use the modpack, then please enjoy it any way you want! I hope that if you do play it, you can relax and enjoy some more laid back Minecraft.
